findings.title: wallet-cdn-without-sri
findings.explanation: Check wallet-cdn-without-sri, severity medium. The page at http://touchstone.test:8080/ loads a third-party wallet library from http://cdn.touchstone.test:8080/ethers.js with no valid SRI integrity hash. A change on the CDN can change the code executed by wallet users. Fix: add a pinned SHA-256 SRI integrity attribute with the crossorigin attribute to that script tag, or host the library on our own origin.

Fix: add an enforcing script-src limited to required origins and object-src 'none'.
